author: vvlbocharov
quote: Lucia is an incredibly brazen and ignorant character. She is arrogant, unprincipled, and stupid all at the same time. There is no option to get rid of her; Jason puts up with all her antics—and, worse yet, this seems to be presented as the "norm" for how a man should behave (a nod to the feminist agenda, Rockstar-style). A guy as tough as him shouldn't be letting people walk all over him; he certainly wouldn't be scavenging through trash. It’s a shame there’s no freedom of choice—no way to reject Lucia.
